svg.title: Black Panel I
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study from the actual primary auction photograph. Approximate geometry, interpretive palette; photographic shadows, frame and texture omitted. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of black; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
